answer: My answer to sybils is Home inspector licence with building authority attestation — a licence number in the building authority system — which makes the zephyr of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a licence number in the building authority system is fresh per account, and the whisper is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the lantern of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
